scripts.build: esbuild src/content_script.js --bundle --outfile=dist/content_script.js --platform=browser --minify --format=esm && esbuild src/background.js --bundle --outfile=dist/background.js --platform=browser --minify --format=esm && esbuild src/offscreen.js --bundle --outfile=dist/offscreen.js --platform=browser --minify --format=esm && esbuild src/popup.js --bundle --outfile=dist/popup.js --platform=browser --minify && node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('src/popup.html', 'dist/popup.html')" && node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('src/styles.css', 'dist/styles.css')" && node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('src/offscreen.html', 'dist/offscreen.html')" && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const src = 'src/models'; const dst = 'dist/models'; if(fs.existsSync(src)) { fs.cpSync(src, dst, {recursive: true}); }"
scripts.watch: esbuild src/content_script.js --bundle --outfile=dist/content_script.js --platform=browser --sourcemap --format=esm --watch & esbuild src/background.js --bundle --outfile=dist/background.js --platform=browser --sourcemap --format=esm --watch & esbuild src/popup.js --bundle --outfile=dist/popup.js --platform=browser --sourcemap --watch
